findings.reason: the new AST prompt-to-response-model test pins rendered text, not the store, so a silent fallback would let the test pass while the declared binding is ignored, which is the "silently shrinks the walk" failure the section's positive control exists to prevent; the plan should name `prompt_loader.py` as the single owner and retire or fail-closed the `_DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NEEDS` fallback for the twelve discovery prompts.
findings.text: §22 asks every discovery prompt to declare its schema provider in frontmatter `schema_needs`, but the same prompt-to-provider binding is already owned by the `_DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NEEDS` dict, which is still consulted as a silent fallback in `get_schema_for_prompt` (prompt_loader.py:1056) and the strict source loader (prompt_loader.py:1363); the plan does not say whether that fallback is retired, so after §22 the binding lives in two stores and a prompt whose frontmatter declaration was dropped or misspelled falls back to a stale dict instead of failing.

rubric_items.deep_module: pass — §22's two changes live in one module (`imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py`, the owner of the structured-call loops): raise on `finish_reason='abort'` and stop forwarding `response_format` inside the single local request builder; §14's prefix predicate is one function (`render_path_prefix_clause`, query_builder.py:268) behind eight call sites, not a new layer.
rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §22 requires every discovery prompt to declare its `schema_needs` provider in frontmatter but does not name what happens to the existing `_DEFAULT_SCHEMA_NEEDS` fallback table, so one binding stays owned by two stores in `imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 0, cli_options 0, mcp_views 0, refusal_families 0; §22 adds no CLI option, MCP view or error family and says so in its own text ("This adds no error family"), and §14 adds no CLI option (its `--root`/`--path-prefix`/`--reset-to` options already exist) and names the inline paths-command block its `reset_to_status` change replaces.
rubric_items.reuse_search: pass — the review searched imas-codex for each mechanism the unimplemented sections add and found the plan extending an existing owner in every case: `_local_call_kwargs` and `EmptyResponseError` in `imas_codex/discovery/base/llm.py`, `schema_needs`/`get_schema_for_prompt` in `imas_codex/llm/prompt_loader.py`, and `render_path_prefix_clause`/`reset_to_status` in `imas_codex/graph/query_builder.py` and `imas_codex/discovery/base/reset.py`.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the §14 reset change extends `reset_to_status` (reset.py:59) rather than wrapping it: it gains a `path_prefixes` argument and renders its own scope through the existing renderer, retiring the paths command's inline clause (paths.py:245-248) rather than adding a parallel scoping path; §22 extends the prompt-schema mechanism rather than wrapping it, and states why the local path cannot simply keep `response_format` (the engine's xgrammar abort).
